meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

howto.what: 帮你调试 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的 bug,在临时工作区做出最小修复并验证。上游 Codex 的缺陷提交 fork PR;LazyCodex 自身的缺陷则提交内嵌补丁的 issue,绝不向该仓库开 PR。
howto.when: 当你要求修复某个 bug、为 bug 提交 PR,或调试并提交 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时触发。

howto.what_en: Debug a LazyCodex or Codex bug, implement the smallest verified fix in a fresh temporary workspace, and deliver it. Upstream openai/codex defects get a fork PR; LazyCodex-owned defects get an issue with the patch embedded, never a PR.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, or open a PR for a bug, or to debug and deliver a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Fix this LazyCodex bug and deliver a verified fix.
say_en.note: Reproduces first, then files an issue or PR

say_en.text: This Codex CLI bug reproduces; open a fix PR for it.

say_en.text: Debug this defect and produce a patch with verification logs.
